notes: Seven own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin. The vendor's own pages disagree on list prices: the pricing page shows Essential, Growth and Premium starting at $62, $192 and $400 per month, while the home page FAQ shows $58, $183 and $375 per month; neither states a billing basis, so claims matching either set were classed true against the page that states them (C04 to C06 rest on the home page FAQ; a reviewer may treat that FAQ as an older own page). The pricing matrix renders its per-plan check marks as images, so plan gating was classed only from the plan highlights and FAQ text. No about, press or newsroom page is linked from the site, so the RealPage acquisition and its date are unverifiable even though the footer states Buildium is a RealPage company. The Marketplace page lists more than 50 partners before a Load More button but states no count, so the two integration-count claims are unverifiable. Six cited pages were read for causes (the 6-page cap): the $55 price was traced to a Shuk Rentals article; Lula, a Yardi Breeze blog post, TurboTenant, DoorLoop and Leasense did not carry the $55 or Lumina statements; the Lumina (C54) and PayNearMe (C64) causes are recorded as not found because the cap was reached before the other cited pages could be read. Hedged lines (may incur, can carry, can add up, can increase) and positioning, ratings, market share and the $580 million and $10.2 billion amounts were not coded. In two Google AI Overviews answers the table header omits the Buildium column name; the first value column was read as Buildium from the row content. The passages file drops lines under bold sub-headings (for example Claude's Pricing bullets) and table rows that do not repeat the vendor name, so the full answer text was also read for every Buildium-headed section and for the Buildium columns of the q7 and q8 comparison tables; instances found there are included. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshot exists for Buildium and no page was blocked or thin; the matrix check marks remain unreadable as text, and the other snapshots were searched again for QuickBooks, unit minimums, contract terms, annual discounts, Thoma Bravo, a 2019 date, Happy Property, Forte and live chat without settling any claim, so nothing was re-classed on new reads. The 32 gap lines add nothing new: each in-scope line about Buildium is already an instance (the $55+, $62 and flat-tier table cells), and the rest are positioning, advice, comparisons with Re-Leased or Yardi Breeze, or lines about DoorLoop, AppFolio, Propertyware and Rentec. The markdown and Google-style tables and Buildium-headed sections added instances only: nine to C18 (ChatGPT table cells and a q8 Claude 3 row naming transaction, payment, e-signature and add-on fees), three to C40 (onboarding costs), q2 ChatGPT 2 to C47 and C52 (evaluate Growth for phone support and reporting automation), q7 ChatGPT 2 to C48 (Essential ticket support alone), and q7 Perplexity 2 to C20 (tiered pricing) and C24 (no minimum listed in Buildium's own materials). Consistency check: C07 was split. The exact statements (Pricing starts at $55+/month, Buildium starts at $55+/month base fees, The monthly base fee starts at $55) stay wrong against both own figures ($58 and $62), with $55+ read as from $55 rather than a lower bound; the four Google answers that say around $55 moved to new claim C83, unverifiable, because an approximation within about 5% of the home page's $58 does not clearly understate it while the two own pages disagree. C54 (Lumina only on Premium) stays wrong: the Essential highlights list Buildium's AI Assistant and the AI page says Lumina AI is available as part of select Buildium plans. C64 (no PayNearMe cash payments) stays wrong: the pricing page offers Retail Cash Payments, powered by PayNearMe.
